fixed.explanation: IntervalArray.__arrow_array__ uses pyarrow.from_numpy_dtype, which fails for DatetimeTZDtype. ArrowIntervalType deserializes the subtype with type_for_alias, which has no alias for tz-aware timestamps. I map DatetimeTZDtype to pyarrow.timestamp(unit, tz). I also parse the "timestamp[unit, tz=...]" string on deserialize.

query.intent: IntervalArray.__arrow_array__ converts the subtype to an arrow type using pyarrow.from_numpy_dtype, which fails for extension dtypes like DatetimeTZDtype. Also ArrowIntervalType (pandas arrow extension type for intervals) serializes the subtype as a string in __arrow_ext_serialize__ and deserializes it with pyarrow.type_for_alias, which fails for tz-aware timestamps.
query.symptom: pa.array of a Series of intervals with tz-aware datetime subtype raises TypeError, and parquet round trip fails with no type alias for the timestamp.
